comment: The case matrix of the user-journey recette. It extends docs/tests/soft-takeoff/cases.json (86 cases, waves W0-W5) without replacing it: a case with `covers` re-uses a soft-takeoff case instead of repeating it. Fields: id Jnn-nn; prio P0 (money wrong, data leaking, cannot start or sign in) P1 (visible defect in a core flow) P2 (polish); runner script (a command decides) | agent (a cheap-model walkthrough that returns evidence) | vision (an agent collects pictures and measures, a stronger model reads them) | owner (a person: real money, real stores, real machines, a decision); env none | sandbox (frozen bundle set) | full (every bundle on, the freeze undone) | replica (local server stand-in) | staging (deployed test server, Stripe test mode) | machine (a real cloud computer) | device (phone simulator, emulator or phone, or an installed desktop app) | site (the public website); status ready | to-verify | needs-build | blocked | gap (a feature the reading says is not built: the case checks that the product does not promise it and records the gap); covers the soft-takeoff case ids it re-uses; known the ids of known-gaps.md the case is expected to hit; how = the command (script), the brief (agent, vision) or what the owner must do (owner). Defaults: personas [A], status ready, surface and env of the journey.
